offers_products.reason: Publishes daily newspapers and digital news products sold by subscription, plus Blox CMS publishing platform.

offers_services.reason: Sells advertising and digital marketing services (Amplified Digital agency) to local businesses; a main revenue line.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Readers subscribe to local newspapers and digital news across 72 markets.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Local businesses buy advertising and marketing services; a major revenue source.

recurring_revenue.reason: Subscriptions plus repeat advertising from local businesses; ongoing subscription and ad relationships.

cyclical_demand.reason: Advertising, its major revenue source, is easily cut by local businesses in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Newspaper subscriptions and local ad buys are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from media products, audience reach and advertising platform, not billed staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are local small businesses advertisers and household readers.

asset_heavy.reason: Shifting to digital; print plants exist but growth doesn't need heavy ongoing capital investment.

notes: Asset-heavy judgment is moderate since it still runs some printing operations.
